content.hebrew: יִתְגַּדַּל  אֵל עֶלְיוֹן, הַשָּׂם לִירֵאָיו עֵינוֹ.
content.english: Magnified be El ‘Elyon, who casts His gaze on those that fear Him.
content.comments: El ‘Elyon. A name for God. Traditional English: “the most high God.”

content.hebrew: יִתְקַדַּשׁ  הַנֹּתֵן חַיִּים וְשָׁלוֹם לְפִינְחָס כֹּהֲנוֹ.
content.transliteration: Yitḳaddash hannoten ḥayyim veshalom lefinḥas kohano.
content.english: Sanctified be the One who gave life and peace to Phineas, His priest.

content.hebrew: יִתְעַלֶּה  רוֹצֶה בוֹ, כִּי מִלֵּא רְצוֹנוֹ.
content.transliteration: Yit‘allē rotsē vo, ki millē retsono.
content.english: Elevated be the One who was pleased with him, for he had fulfilled His will.

content.hebrew: יִתְפָּאַר  נוֹשֵׂא לוֹ וְהֵשִׁיב אֵת חֲרוֹנוֹ.
content.transliteration: Yitpa’ar nose lo veheshiv et ḥarono.
content.english: Glorified be the One who pardoned him, whose wrath he averted.

content.hebrew: וְכִפֶּר עַל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל, [עַם] מַרְעִיתוֹ וְצֹאנוֹ.
content.english: And he atoned for the Israelites, the people He shepherds, His flock.

content.hebrew: כָּרַת בְּרִית בֵּינוֹ לְבֵינוֹ,
content.english: [God] made a covenant between Himself and him,

content.hebrew: לְעוֹלָם תִּהְיֶה לּוֹ כְהֻנָּה, לִבְנוֹ וּלְנִינוֹ.
content.transliteration: Le‘olam tihyē lo khehunna, livno ulnino.
content.english: That his priesthood would be eternal, for his sons and descendants.

content.hebrew: בֵּית־אֵל יְהַלֵּךְ, וְיַחֲזֵק יַד יְמִינוֹ,
content.english: He went to Bethel, and [God] held his right hand tight.

content.hebrew: שֵׁם אֵל עֲדָנָיו, וְזִכְרוֹ תַּֽחַת לְשׁוֹנוֹ.
content.english: God’s name is his delight, and mention of Him is under his tongue.

content.hebrew: וּבְקִרְבּוֹ הֲדַר אֵל, וּבִלְבָבוֹ גְאוֹנוֹ.
content.english: Within him is God’s beauty, and in his heart is His pride.

content.hebrew: יִתְהַדַּר וְיִתְנַשֵּׂא מֶֽלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל וְקֹנוֹ,
content.english: Beautified and uplifted be Israel’s king, their maker,

content.hebrew: הַמַּעֲנִיק רָזֵי תוֹרָתוֹ לְעַם הֲמוֹנוֹ.
content.english: Who has bequeathed the secrets of His Torah to the masses of His people.

content.hebrew: הַשָּׂם תַּֽחַת נְבִיאוֹ, יְהוֹשֻֽׁעַ לְרֹעֶה זִמְּנוֹ.
content.transliteration: Hassam taḥat nevi’o, Yehoshu’a‘ lero‘ē zimmeno.
content.english: He gave a replacement for His prophet, appointing Joshua as shepherd.

content.hebrew: שֹׁמֵר אֲדֹנָיו יְכֻבַּד, וְיַעֲמֹד עַל כַּנּוֹ;
content.english: He who guarded his master was shown honor, and stood in his position;

content.hebrew: הֶעֱנִיקוֹ מֵהוֹד רַבּוֹ וְאוֹנוֹ.
content.english: He bequeathed him some of his master’s glory and strength.

content.hebrew: וְכָל־טוּב חִדֵּשׁ בִּזְמַנּוֹ,
content.english: And [God] designated a good thing for each occasion,

content.hebrew: חֹֽדֶשׁ וְשַׁבָּת וְיוֹם מוֹעֵד – עוֹלַת קָרְבָּנוֹ.
content.english: New Moon, Sabbath, and holidays—burnt offerings.

content.hebrew: אֵין כֵּאלֹהֵֽינוּ. מֹשֵׁל כֹּל מִמְּעוֹנוֹ,
content.english: None is like our God, Who rules over everything from His heaven,

content.hebrew: אֵין כַּאדֹנֵֽינוּ, וּמִי יַעֲשֶׂה כִּרְצוֹנוֹ?
content.english: None is like our Lord, And who can do according to their [own] wish?

content.hebrew: קהל:וְאֵין צוּר בִּלְעָדָיו, וּמִי יֶשְׁנוֹ?
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Ve’en tsur bil‘adav, umi yeshno?
content.english: Cong. And there is no rock aside from Him. Who could there be?

content.hebrew: חזן: אֵֽין־קָד֥וֹשׁ כַּיו֖י כִּי־אֵ֣ין בִּלְתֶּ֑ךָ וְאֵ֥ין צ֖וּר כֵּֽאלֹהֵֽינוּ: (שמואל א ב:ב)
content.transliteration: Ḥazzan: En ḳadosh ka’Adonai ki en biltekha ve’en tsur kelohenu:
content.english: Cantor. There is none holy like Adonai, for there is none but You; and there is no rock like our God. (1 Sam. 2:2)

content.hebrew: קהל: וְאַתָּ֥ה קָד֑וֹשׁ י֝וֹשֵׁ֗ב תְּהִלּ֥וֹת יִשְׂרָאֵֽל: (תהלים כב:ד)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Ve’atta ḳadosh yoshev tehillot Yisra’el:
content.english: Congregation: And You are holy, enthroned on Israel’s praises. (Ps. 22:4)
